_about: Shown on the Validation page. Every number is copied from a result file in verification/ (named in 'file'); update together.

tests.id_txt: GPU vs CPU: hasil mesin kartu grafis sama dengan mesin acuan di prosesor pada medan asli (kotak Manggarai, 2 jam hujan 1 Jan 2020).
tests.en_txt: GPU vs CPU: the graphics-card engine gives the same result as the processor reference on real terrain (Manggarai box, first 2 h of the 1 Jan 2020 storm).

tests.id_txt: Neraca air: hujan + air hulu = resapan + keluar + ke laut + tersimpan. Diuji otomatis dan dilaporkan di setiap simulasi.
tests.en_txt: Water balance: rain + upstream inflow = infiltration + outflow + sea + storage. Tested automatically and reported with every run.
metrics: Mass error, whole region 30 h (90 m)

tests.id_txt: Uji analitik gelombang banjir di dataran datar (Hunter dkk. 2005): skema numerik yang sama dengan mesin v2.
tests.en_txt: Analytical flood-wave test on a flat plane (Hunter et al. 2005): same numerical scheme as engine v2.

tests.id_txt: Dibanding model terbitan SFINCS 2.4.0 (Deltares) pada medan, hujan dan kekasaran yang sama (mesin v1, skema sama; v2 akan diuji ulang).
tests.en_txt: Against the published SFINCS 2.4.0 model (Deltares) on the same terrain, rain and roughness (engine v1, same scheme; v2 re-run pending).

tests.id_txt: Dibanding banjir teramati (1 Jan 2020 dan satu kejadian lain: laporan PetaBencana, citra radar Sentinel-1). Belum dilakukan: ini langkah berikutnya, termasuk kalibrasi kapasitas drainase kota dari data teramati.
tests.en_txt: Against observed floods (1 Jan 2020 and one more event: PetaBencana reports, Sentinel-1 radar). Not done yet: next step, including calibrating the city drainage capacity on observed data.
